steps.cmd: RUN printf '%s\n' 'import multiprocessing, runpy, sys' 'multiprocessing.set_start_method("fork", force=True)' 'sys.argv = ["setup.py"] + sys.argv[1:]' 'runpy.run_path("setup.py", run_name="__main__")' > /opt/cupy/build-wheel.py && cat /opt/cupy/build-wheel.py

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=aws,required=false if [ -s /run/secrets/aws ]; then set -a; . /run/secrets/aws; set +a; fi; njobs=""; if [ -z "${njobs}" ]; then cores=$(nproc); njobs=$(awk -v per="2" '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2/1024/1024/per)}' /proc/meminfo); [ -n "${njobs}" ] || njobs=${cores}; [ "

RUN sed -i -e 's|https://tritonlang.blob.core.windows.net/llvm-builds|https://oaitriton.blob.core.windows.net/public/llvm-builds|g' setup.py && echo "llvm host references: $(grep -c 'blob.core.windows.net' setup.py || true)"

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=aws,required=false if [ -s /run/secrets/aws ]; then set -a; . /run/secrets/aws; set +a; fi; if [ -z "" ]; then cores=$(nproc); jobs=$(awk -v per="2" '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2/1024/1024/per)}' /proc/meminfo); [ -n "${jobs}" ] || jobs=${cores}; [ "${jobs}" -ge 1 ] || j
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir build && pip install --no-cache-dir --group dev && pip install --no-cache-dir mkl-static mkl-include

RUN --mount=type=bind,from=torchwheels,source=/wheels,target=/wheels pip install --no-cache-dir /wheels/*.whl && python -c "import torch; print('installed torch', torch.__version__)"

RUN --mount=type=bind,from=tritonwheels,source=/wheels,target=/triton-wheels pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps /triton-wheels/*.whl && python -c "import triton; print('installed triton', triton.__version__)"

RUN python -c "import tomllib; print(chr(10).join(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['build-system']['requires']))" > /tmp/build-reqs.txt && echo "--- AITER build-system requires ---" && cat /tmp/build-reqs.txt && pip install --no-cache-dir -r /tmp/build-reqs.txt && pip install --no-cache-dir

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=aws,required=false if [ -s /run/secrets/aws ]; then set -a; . /run/secrets/aws; set +a; fi; if [ -z "" ]; then cores=$(nproc); jobs=$(awk -v per="1" '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2/1024/1024/per)}' /proc/meminfo); [ -n "${jobs}" ] || jobs=${cores}; [ "${jobs}" -ge 1 ] || j

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "meson>=1.4" meson-python ninja pybind11 patchelf auditwheel build tomlkit pyyaml types-PyYAML pytest uv "setuptools>=80.9.0" && uv --version

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=aws,required=false if [ -s /run/secrets/aws ]; then set -a; . /run/secrets/aws; set +a; fi; ./contrib/tomlutil.py --wheel-name nixl-rocm pyproject.toml && CC="sccache gcc" CXX="sccache g++" python -m build --wheel --no-isolation --outdir /tmp/nixl_wheels -C setup-args=-Duc

RUN njobs=""; if [ -z "${njobs}" ]; then cores=$(nproc); njobs=$(awk -v per="2" '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2/1024/1024/per)}' /proc/meminfo); [ -n "${njobs}" ] || njobs=${cores}; [ "${njobs}" -ge 1 ] || njobs=1; [ "${njobs}" -le "${cores}" ] || njobs=${cores}; fi; export MAX_JOBS="${njobs}"; echo
RUN python -c "import triton; print('triton', triton.__version__)" && python -c "import aiter; print('aiter ok')" && python -c "from nixl._api import nixl_agent; print('nixl ok')"

RUN cp requirements/rocm.txt /tmp/rocm.txt.orig && sed -i -E "/^(tensorizer|runai-model-streamer|amd-quark|tilelang|apache-tvm-ffi|mooncake-transfer-engine-rocm|datasets|peft|pytest-asyncio)([<=>\[[:space:]]|$)/d" requirements/rocm.txt && echo "--- dropped from requirements/rocm.txt ---" && diff /tm
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements/rocm.txt && python -c "import torch; print('torch still', torch.__version__, torch.version.hip)"
